cases: cancel while native Bot is busy
abort while another binding occupies the native queue

behavior: Cancellation and transport abort are checked before each preparation stage and native send.
Core/local task controls are polled before and during native idle waits.
Aborted queue entries settle and persist without waiting for another binding to release the native queue; skipped native queue callbacks do not write or send later.
Detaching waits for all accepted bridge requests and their final writes.
Already submitting native messages are allowed to settle admission; cancellation then removes the matching inbox occurrence or cancels only the correlated native turn.
Late cancellation lookups cannot cancel a different turn.
Transport detach preserves underlying native work that was already admitted and records an unknown result.
limits: No real host or provider was exercised by this regression. Real natural-scene acceptance belongs to the parent integration thread.
